productContract.summary: One editable deterministic simulation produces both an interactive explainer and a rendered video from the same timeline.
limitations: Educational simplified ring-road model, not a calibrated traffic prediction system.
No paid API is required for the core demo.
Browser MediaRecorder timestamps are wall-clock based, so WebM container duration can differ slightly from the deterministic model timeline duration.

milestones.goal: Repository setup and deterministic simulation core
Interactive editor, save/load, shared preview/export timeline, automated verification
Real browser export verification and UX hardening
Project format validation, demos and edge-case handling
Repository-owned screenshots, captured demo and architecture documentation
Release acceptance assessment only; no automatic rollover
